title: Nine findings, and where to read each one
title_zh: 九個發現，以及各自該讀哪一頁
lede: The 2026 Best Wiki winners all build a layer like this — each claim in two sentences, with a link straight to the evidence. It works, so this report does it too.
lede_zh: 2026 年所有最佳 Wiki 得主都建了一層像這樣的東西——每個主張兩句話，附上直達證據的連結。它有效，所以這份報告也這麼做。

cards.title: Closing the model–data loop is the single best predictor of a Top 10
cards.title_zh: 閉合模型與資料的迴圈，是 Top 10 最強的單一預測因子
cards.body: Teams that both fit a model to their own measured data and validate it against something held back reached a Top 10 at **53%**; teams that did not, at **23%** — less than half the rate. All nine who closed the loop without a Top 10 won or were nominated for a major special prize anyway. It needs no GPU and no licence.
cards.body_zh: 既以自身量測資料擬合模型、又用保留資料加以驗證的團隊，進入 Top 10 的比例是 **53%**；沒有這麼做的則是 **23%**，不到一半。閉合了迴圈卻未進 Top 10 的那九支，全都拿下或入圍了重要特別獎。這件事不需要 GPU，也不需要授權。

cards.title: At high-school level the gap is evaluation discipline, not tools
cards.title_zh: 在高中層級，差距在評估紀律，不在工具
cards.body: Eton-College-UK used logistic regression and a PSSM but ran cluster-aware cross-validation, a label-shuffle control and an ablation. Lambert-GA won Best Model for benchmarking the confidence metrics themselves and publishing that its own hit was not top-scoring. GCGS reached the Top 10 with no model page at all.
cards.body_zh: Eton-College-UK 用的是 logistic regression 與 PSSM，但做了分群感知的交叉驗證、標籤洗牌對照與消融測試。Lambert-GA 拿下最佳模型，是因為他們對信心指標本身做了基準測試，並公開自己成功的設計其實分數不是最高的。GCGS 則在完全沒有 model 頁的情況下進入 Top 10。

cards.title: 8 of 21 award-winning tools are still usable, and the reason is hosting
cards.title_zh: 21 個得獎工具中有 8 個仍可使用，原因是「有沒有架站」
cards.body: Every live tool was hosted on wiki-freeze day; every source-only tool's wiki lists localhost as its only address. Not a coding or budget decision — a hosting decision made months early. Two high-school teams out-shipped most of the universities. Stars and forks across every repo checked: zero.
cards.body_zh: 每一個仍在線的工具，在 wiki 凍結當日就已經上線；每一個只有原始碼的工具，wiki 上唯一的位址都是 localhost。這不是寫程式或預算的決定，而是提前好幾個月做的架站決定。兩支高中隊伍交付得比多數大學還好。所有檢查過的 repository，star 與 fork 都是零。

cards.title: The best figures build the reader's doubt into the picture
cards.title_zh: 最好的圖，把讀者的懷疑畫進圖裡
cards.body: GEMS-Taiwan's provenance rail turns amber exactly where measurement stops and modelling begins. DKU gives "not assessed" its own verdict so an unmeasured gate cannot read as a passed one. Mingdao's captions carry the instrument, the buffer, the replicate count and a link to the raw CSV. DTU shows which stakeholders never replied.
cards.body_zh: GEMS-Taiwan 的來源軌道，正好在量測結束、模擬開始之處轉為琥珀色。DKU 給「未評估」一個自己的判定，讓未量測的關卡不會被讀成通過。Mingdao 的圖說載明儀器、緩衝液、重複次數，並連結原始 CSV。DTU 則把從未回覆的利害關係人也顯示出來。

cards.title: The deadline, not the people, is what limits Science for Good
cards.title_zh: 限制 Science for Good 的是截止日，不是人
cards.body: 8 of 21 award-winning software tools still run, every repository checked has zero stars and zero forks, no team in 106 ran an inter-lab measurement ring, and only nine or ten of 71 closed loops were closed by a non-expert. These are deadline artefacts. GEMS's answer is a **club-form programme with no deadline**, carrying a few problems across years — its definition, criteria and current pipeline are on this tab.
cards.body_zh: 21 個得獎軟體工具中有 8 個還能跑，所有檢查過的程式庫星數與分支數皆為零，106 支隊伍沒有一支做過跨實驗室量測環，71 個閉合的迴路中只有九到十個是與非專業人士閉合的。這些都是截止日造成的。GEMS 的回應是一個**沒有截止日的社團式長期計畫**，讓幾個題目跨年走下去——它的定義、條件與目前的題目清單都在這一頁。

cards.title: The loops that closed were closed by experts, not by publics
cards.title_zh: 真正閉合的迴圈，是專家閉合的，不是公眾
cards.body: Of all 106 decorated teams, **71** can point at a stakeholder who visibly changed the design. But almost every one of those stakeholders was a credentialled technical expert. The publics, patients and communities the criterion is rhetorically about changed the vocabulary and not the vector, with **nine or ten exceptions in 106**. (The first pass scored 93 files and found 64 and six-to-seven; the figures here are the recount on the closed set.)
cards.body_zh: 在全部 106 支獲獎隊伍中，有 **71** 支能指出一位明顯改變了設計的利害關係人。但這些利害關係人幾乎全是具備專業資格的技術專家。這個評審標準修辭上所指向的公眾、病人與社群，改變的是詞彙而不是方向——**106 支中只有九到十個例外**。（第一輪評的是 93 份檔案，得到 64 支與六到七個例外；這裡的數字是集合封閉後的重算。）

cards.title: The best education work was designed from data and measured like an experiment
cards.title_zh: 最好的教育工作，是從資料設計、像實驗一樣量測的
cards.body: UCAS-China made compliance the target after a 461-person questionnaire, not awareness. GU Frankfurt sent nineteen members to a professional science-communication course first. Oxford built a podcast that deliberately pairs stakeholders who disagree. And the sharpest teams publish the lesson that failed.
cards.body_zh: UCAS-China 在做完 461 人的問卷後，把目標設為服藥遵從性，而不是認知提升。GU Frankfurt 先送 19 位成員去上專業的科學傳播課程。Oxford 做了一個刻意把意見相左者配對的 podcast。而最犀利的團隊，會把失敗的那堂課也公布出來。

cards.title: The credible commercial sections published a model showing their own product losing
cards.title_zh: 可信的商業章節，都公開了顯示自家產品輸掉的模型
cards.body: Worldshaper-Shanghai reports a negative NPV for its own enzyme. DTU-Denmark's LCA finds cement co-processing beats its route on almost every indicator, then converts each loss into an engineering target. Stockholm dismantled its venture when the safety board killed open-water release — and won the Safety and Security Award.
cards.body_zh: Worldshaper-Shanghai 報告自家酵素得出負的 NPV。DTU-Denmark 的 LCA 發現水泥共處理在幾乎每項指標上都勝過他們的路線，接著把每一項落敗轉成工程目標。Stockholm 在安全委員會否決開放水域釋放後拆掉了自己的創業計畫——然後拿下安全與保安獎。

cards.title: Best Wiki winners ship an executive layer, not better graphics
cards.title_zh: 最佳 Wiki 得主交付的是一個導讀層，不是更漂亮的圖
cards.body: Three of the four serve text that is readable before any script runs; the fourth mirrors every page as Markdown. All four build a layer that answers each medal criterion in two or three sentences and deep-links the evidence, failures included. Dark mode, late alt-text sweeps and mascot systems correlate with nothing.
cards.body_zh: 四位得主中有三位提供的文字在任何程式執行前就可閱讀；第四位則把每一頁都鏡像為 Markdown。四位都建了一層用兩三句話回答每項獎牌標準、並直接深連到證據（含失敗）的導讀層。深色模式、最後才補的替代文字、吉祥物系統，則與得獎毫無相關。

cards.title: Taiwan won well, but only in the high-school tier
cards.title_zh: 台灣贏得不錯，但只贏在高中組
cards.body: Thirteen competing teams returned six award wins — more than any East Asian territory except China, and more than Hong Kong on fewer teams. But every technical award came from the high-school tier, there were zero nominations in any parts award and zero in Best Software, and Hong Kong tripled Taiwan's Top 10 count.
cards.body_zh: 13 支參賽隊伍拿下 6 座獎項——多於中國以外的任何東亞地區，而且以更少的隊伍數超越香港。但所有技術類獎項都來自高中組，在任何元件獎與最佳軟體上都掛零，而香港的 Top 10 席次是台灣的三倍。

cards.title: The divide is not medical versus agricultural — it is platform versus applied
cards.title_zh: 分界不在醫療與農業之間，而在平台與應用之間
cards.body: Therapeutics teams close loops with non-experts about as often as bioremediation teams do. What actually separates the field is whether anyone outside a lab ever operates the thing: across the platform villages — Foundational Advance, Space, Software & AI, Biomanufacturing — **2 of 26** decorated teams closed a design loop at all, against **14 of 45** in the applied villages.
cards.body_zh: 治療類團隊與生物復育類團隊，和非專業人士閉合迴路的頻率其實差不多。真正分開這個領域的，是有沒有實驗室以外的人實際操作這個東西：在平台類賽道——Foundational Advance、Space、Software & AI、Biomanufacturing——**26 支得獎隊伍中只有 2 支**曾閉合設計迴路，應用類賽道則是 **45 支中有 14 支**。

cards.title: Nobody ran an inter-lab measurement ring — in a competition about measurement
cards.title_zh: 沒有任何一支隊伍做過跨實驗室量測環——在一個以量測為核心的競賽裡
cards.body: 69 of 106 decorated teams record working with another team, but almost all of it is meet-ups. **Not one** ran an inter-lab measurement ring, and collaboration does not predict placing: substantive collaborators reached a Top 10 at 29%, attendance-only teams at 48%. The one team that offered to do real shared work publicly got **zero replies** — and won Best Software and Best Wiki anyway.
cards.body_zh: 106 支得獎隊伍中有 69 支記錄了與其他隊伍的合作，但幾乎全是 meet-up。**沒有任何一支**做過跨實驗室量測環；而且合作並不預測名次：有實質合作的隊伍進入 Top 10 的比例是 29%，只去參加聚會的反而是 48%。唯一公開提議要做真正共同工作的那支隊伍，**一封回覆都沒有收到**——卻仍拿下最佳軟體與最佳 Wiki。

cards.title: Nobody measured an escape rate
cards.body: 19 of 106 decorated teams describe a genetic containment device. **Zero** report a measured escape frequency, and only two name a DNA-synthesis screening regime. The sharpest result in the category is a negative one: the Safety winner found that a published Addgene kill switch failed first, weeks before its own circuits.
cards.body_zh: 106 支得獎隊伍中有 19 支描述了基因層級的圍堵裝置。**沒有一支**報告量測到的逸出頻率，只有兩支指名了 DNA 合成訂單的篩查機制。這個類別最銳利的結果是一個負面結果：安全獎得主發現，一個已發表的 Addgene 自殺開關比他們自己的電路更早失效，而且早了好幾週。

cards.title: Winning parts are won on documentation, not on novelty
cards.title_zh: 得獎元件靠的是文件，不是新穎性
cards.body: Winners' headline parts carry **10,388 to 83,030 characters** of registry documentation across three to six typed documents; sampled nominee parts carry 440 to 2,500, usually Design only. The high-school basic-part winner is a 247 bp native promoter copied from GenBank. Both improved-part awards had **zero nominees** — the cheapest category in iGEM to enter.
cards.body_zh: 得獎隊伍的代表元件在註冊庫上帶著 **10,388 到 83,030 個字元**的文件，分布在三到六份分類文件中；抽樣的入圍元件則是 440 到 2,500 字，通常只有 Design 一項。高中組基礎元件得主是一段從 GenBank 複製來的 247 bp 原生啟動子。兩個改良元件獎項都是**零入圍**——那是 iGEM 裡最便宜的參賽門檻。

method: Each card summarises an analysis published in full on the tab it links to, where the evidence, the named teams and the limits of the method are set out. Where a finding rests on a number, the analysis says how the number was computed and what it cannot see.
method_zh: 每一張卡片都是某篇完整分析的摘要，點進連結的頁面即可看到證據、具名的團隊，以及該方法的限制。凡是以數字為基礎的發現，分析中都會說明該數字如何計算，以及它看不到什麼。
